entries.test: Public financial records and reporting on Situational Awareness's losses, leverage, and management decisions could establish its downfall and the asserted causes.
entries.note: “Collapsed” is stronger than “downfall,” and “AI-focused” is added. “Hubris-fueled” makes a causal assertion.

entries.test: OpenAI's price announcements and public evidence about competitive pricing and the reasons for its decision could establish whether competition drove the 80% cut.
entries.note: The embedded announcement identifies Luna as receiving the 80% cut; Terra received a 20% cut.
The sarcastic question does not commit to the proposition that profit margins are being eliminated.
Marcus mockingly adopts OpenAI's voice using a familiar joke about losses and volume. It is not a literal assertion about the economics of every inference.

entries.test: Public incident disclosures and contemporaneous reporting could establish whether Anthropic experienced a cybersecurity incident.
entries.note: The mocking wording still asserts an identifiable factual event.

entries.test: MIT Technology Review's contemporaneous coverage would establish whether it reported new developments in AI jailbreaking.
entries.note: “New adventures” does not necessarily mean new techniques; the normalization adds specificity.

entries.test: Narayanan and colleagues' public report and research evaluations would establish whether they found AI scientist systems inadequate, particularly for open-ended research.
entries.note: The substantive assessment is explicitly attributed to Narayanan and colleagues. Marcus reports their conclusion without separately asserting it in his own voice.
